confirmed.answer_text: #TYPE 1 UNCUT is an online resource and video platform for young people with Type 1 diabetes, created in collaboration with Diabetes UK and Garfield Weston Foundation.
cited_statements: #type1uncut started with Garfield Weston Foundation getting together with Diabetes UK to provide an online resource for young people with Type1 diabetes.
They now make and publish videos on the subjects they really care about on youtube.com/type1uncut
